content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes electric motors, drives and motion controllers, not bearings or mechanical power transmission products."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Builds asphalt plants, crushers and drills for road and quarry customers, a different equipment business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Distributes electronic components and fasteners from stock rather than manufacturing bearings or power transmission products."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Primarily makes pumps and valves; its friction and connector lines only partly overlap with bearings and power transmission."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Designs and builds engines and generator sets, a different product category from bearings and transmission components."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells paints, coatings and specialty materials made from chemical inputs, not mechanical components."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sells process fluids, lubricants and chemical coatings with technical services, not bearings or drive components."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Makes precision roller and ball bearings for aerospace and industrial OEMs and distributors, closely matching the target's bearing business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Makes locks, hinges, security devices and metal castings, which are hardware products rather than bearings."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Makes industrial heat tracing and process heating systems for plant operators, a different product and customer business."}]}
